# MMDB test fixtures

These small synthetic databases come from MaxMind's official MaxMind-DB
repository at https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/tree/main/test-data.
They are test data, not production geolocation databases. The repository is
dual licensed under MIT and Apache-2.0; LICENSE-MIT is reproduced here.

They cover City/Country/ASN records, 24/28/32-bit search trees, IPv4/IPv6,
and the data types used by the range reader.
